text: An Oklahoma City jury found Toyota Motor Corp. at fault in a 2007 crash blamed on a Camry accelerating on its own that killed a passenger and injured the driver; it awarded $3 million in compensatory damages and found Toyota guilty of "reckless disregard" for failing to correct a dangerous situation.
short: An Oklahoma City jury found Toyota Motor Corp. at fault in a 2007 unintended-acceleration crash that killed a passenger.

source.name: UPI
source.quote: A jury in Oklahoma City said Toyota Motor Corp. was at fault in a 2007 crash that killed a woman and was blamed on a Camry accelerating on its own
